article.title: Xnurta MCP加入廣告寫入，預算與出價變動須先確認
article.summary: Xnurta宣布擴展MCP連接，讓AI助理以自然語言建立、調整及管理Amazon贊助廣告。
highlights: 預算、出價和封存變動須先顯示預覽，並由人員確認後生效。
article.why: 從分析走到帳戶寫入，會直接改變零售媒體操作風險；團隊可決定哪些批次修改適合由助理提出再審批。
article.next_step: 以一組促銷後需要還原的預算測試預覽，核對活動清單、原金額和擬改金額，再確認支援的動作。
article.detail: MCP是一種讓AI助理連接外部工具的協定。Xnurta表示，更新後可批次調整預算、出價、關鍵字和定向，也可按既有範本建立活動。Amazon DSP的唯讀接入仍屬後續計劃。團隊可以先檢查批次預覽是否完整列出受影響活動，並把寫入權限限制在可回查和批准的操作範圍內。
article.title_en: Xnurta MCP adds ad write actions with confirmation for bids and budgets
article.summary_en: Xnurta expanded its MCP connection so AI assistants can create, adjust and manage Amazon sponsored ads through natural-language instructions.
highlights_en: It supports Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display.
Budget, bid and archive changes require a preview and human confirmation before taking effect.
article.why_en: Moving from analysis to account writes changes retail media operations. Teams can choose which bulk changes an assistant may propose for review.
article.next_step_en: Test a post-promotion budget reset preview and reconcile campaign names, old amounts and proposed amounts before confirmation.
article.detail_en: MCP is a protocol connecting AI assistants to external tools. Xnurta lists bulk budget, bid, keyword and targeting adjustments and template-based creation. Read-only Amazon DSP access remains planned. Teams can check that previews show all affected campaigns and limit writes to operations they can review and approve.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
